On 18 December 2000, the Governorship of Ankara issued a circular providing guidelines on meetings and demonstrations organised in the city of Ankara.
The circular issued by the Governorship of Ankara on 18 December 2000 was issued in accordance with the Law on Meetings and Demonstration Marches (Law no. 2911).
Article 34 of the Turkish Constitution provides that everyone has the right to hold unarmed and peaceful meetings and demonstration marches without prior permission.

Article 34 of the Turkish Constitution provides that the formalities, conditions, and procedures governing the exercise of the right to hold meetings and demonstration marches shall be prescribed by law.

At the material time, section 10 of the Meetings and Demonstration Marches Act (Law no. 2911) required that, in order for a meeting to take place, the governor's office or authorities of the district in which the demonstration is planned must be informed during opening hours and at least seventy-two hours prior to the meeting.
